name: NSFDC Micro Credit Finance (MCF)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: Up to 5% p.a. to beneficiary via SCA; 1% rebate on timely repayment may apply through State Channelising Agencies.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90%–100% project financing by NSFDC/SCA; state-level SC margin money subsidy of up to ₹10,000 may be clubbed where applicable.
overview: Provides small, quick-disbursal micro-credit for Scheduled Caste individuals and Self-Help Groups starting micro-enterprises or retail activities. Offered at a concessional rate through State Channelising Agencies, Regional Rural Banks, and partner MFIs.
key_highlights: Low concessional interest around 5% p.a. through SCAs
Supports both individual micro-vendors and SHG/JLG groups
Minimal collateral requirements for small working capital
Flexible 36-month repayment cycle with 1-month initial grace
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate issued by Tehsildar/SDM
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Bank Passbook / Jan Dhan account details
SHG resolution and member list (if applying as a group)
Passport-size photographs and brief activity note
important_notes: Strictly restricted to Scheduled Caste (SC) applicants with annual family income up to ₹5 lakh.
Maximum loan cap is ₹60,000 per beneficiary; larger projects should consider NSFDC Term Loan or PMMY.
Interest rates vary slightly if routed through NBFC-MFIs instead of State Channelising Agencies.

name: NSFDC Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 4% p.a. concessional interest rate for SC women beneficiaries through State Channelising Agencies.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 95% project funding with state-level SC margin money subsidy up to ₹10,000 where eligible.
overview: Dedicated micro-finance scheme empowering Scheduled Caste women entrepreneurs and women SHGs to start small trades, tailoring, beauty, or service units. Delivers one of India's lowest institutional interest rates at 4% per annum.
key_highlights: Ultra-low 4% p.a. interest exclusively for SC women
Up to ₹1,00,000 financing for individual or SHG units
3-month moratorium period before first EMI starts
95% project cost coverage reduces upfront cash burden
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate of the woman applicant
Aadhaar Card and Residence Proof
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Women SHG registration & resolution (if group loan)
Bank Account Passbook (DBT / Aadhaar seeded)
Passport-size photographs and equipment quotation
important_notes: Strictly open only to women entrepreneurs belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) community.
Annual family income ceiling is ₹5,00,000 across rural and urban areas.
Sanction and disbursement timelines depend on your State Channelising Agency quota.

name: NSFDC Mahila Kisan Yojana (MKY)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 4.5% to 5% p.a. concessional interest for SC women engaged in agriculture and allied activities.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90% project finance by NSFDC/SCA; eligible state agri/SC subsidies may be dovetailed.
overview: Supports Scheduled Caste women farmers and rural women collectives in dairy, poultry, mushroom cultivation, horticulture, and allied farming activities. Includes a 6-month moratorium aligned with seasonal crop and livestock income cycles.
key_highlights: Concessional ~4.5% p.a. rate for SC women farmers
Loan limit up to ₹2,00,000 for farm and allied units
6-month moratorium matches harvest or lactation cycles
Available to both individual women farmers and SHGs
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Land ownership record (Khatauni/Jamabandi) or lease agreement
Aadhaar Card and Voter ID / Ration Card
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Bank Passbook and 2 passport-size photographs
important_notes: Applicable only to SC women applicants engaged in agriculture or allied rural livelihoods.
Proof of cultivable land ownership, family land consent, or lease is required by the SCA/bank.
Repayment tenure extends up to 48 months including the 6-month moratorium.

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme (TL)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 6% to 8% p.a. tiered by loan quantum (6% up to ₹5L, 7%–8% for higher slabs; 1% women rebate).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90% of project cost financed (promoter contribution 5%–10%); no direct central capital subsidy unless dovetailed.
overview: NSFDC's flagship Term Loan supports viable manufacturing, service, transport, and trading enterprises set up by Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs. Finances up to 90% of project costs for medium-scale units through SCAs and public sector banks.
key_highlights: High loan ceiling up to ₹30,00,000 (higher slabs up to ₹45L via banks)
Concessional 6%–8% p.a. interest with 1% rebate for women
6-month gestation/moratorium period for unit setup
Covers machinery, commercial vehicles, and fixed assets
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Detailed Project Report (DPR) with cash-flow projections
Machinery / Equipment / Vehicle proforma quotations
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Address Proof
Family Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000) and Bank Statements
Udyam Registration and premises rent/ownership proof
important_notes: Minimum loan size starts at ₹2,00,000; smaller needs fit Laghu Vyavsay or Micro Credit Finance.
Requires a viable project report and 5%–10% promoter margin money contribution.
Collateral or third-party guarantee norms depend on the State Channelising Agency or lending bank.

name: NSFDC Educational Loan Scheme (ELS)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 4% p.a. for male students and 3.5% p.a. for female students (0.5% concession for women) during repayment.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90% of course fees and living expenses financed; eligible for Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) during moratorium.
overview: Provides low-interest education loans to Scheduled Caste students pursuing full-time professional, technical, or degree courses in recognized Indian or overseas institutions. Offers a repayment holiday covering the course period plus one year.
key_highlights: Very low 3.5%–4% p.a. interest rate for SC students
Covers tuition, hostel, books, and examination fees up to ₹20L
Long 84-month repayment window after study moratorium
0.5% additional interest concession for female students
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate of the student
Confirmed Admission Letter from recognized university/college
Official Fee Structure schedule from the institution
Previous academic mark sheets (10th, 12th, graduation)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Parents' Income Certificate (<= ₹5L)
Co-borrower (parent/guardian) KYC and bank passbook
important_notes: Only for full-time professional/technical courses in India (up to ₹20L) or abroad (higher cap).
Co-borrower (parent/guardian) signature and income verification are mandatory.
Compare with PM-Vidyalaxmi if family income is between ₹5L and ₹8L.

name: NSFDC Laghu Vyavsay Yojana (LVY)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 6% p.a. fixed concessional interest rate for micro and small business units up to ₹5 lakh.
subsidy_margin_note: 90% loan finance with 5%–10% promoter contribution; state SC subsidy up to ₹10,000 may apply.
overview: Designed specifically for Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs launching retail shops, repair workshops, IT kiosks, or small service enterprises up to ₹5 lakh. Bridges the gap between micro-credit and larger industrial Term Loans.
key_highlights: Covers ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 business setup requirements
Predictable 6% p.a. interest over 5-year repayment tenure
3-month initial moratorium for shop stocking and setup
Ideal for kirana stores, salons, fabrication, and service units
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Shop/unit rent agreement or municipal ownership document
Supplier quotations for stock, tools, or furniture
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Udyam Registration Certificate and bank statement
important_notes: Restricted to SC applicants with annual family income up to ₹5,00,000.
Minimum 5%–10% promoter margin money must be arranged by the applicant.
Faster processing when applied via PM-SURAJ or your district SCA office.

name: NSFDC Green Business Scheme (GBS)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 5% p.a. concessional green credit rate (lower than standard Term Loan for climate-friendly projects).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90% project finance; can be paired with MNRE/EV subsidies where permitted by state policy.
overview: Promotes climate-resilient livelihoods among Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs, including e-rickshaws, solar cold storage, biogas, polyhouses, and eco-friendly packaging units. Offers an extra interest discount compared to standard term loans.
key_highlights: Lower 5% p.a. green interest rate for clean-tech businesses
Finances EVs, solar pumps/mills, and waste-recycling units up to ₹20L
Extended 72-month tenure keeps monthly EMIs affordable
6-month moratorium supports installation and commissioning
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Technical quotation for green equipment / EV / solar unit
Detailed Project Report (DPR) showing energy/environmental benefit
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Driving Licence (if e-vehicle)
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
important_notes: Project must qualify as an eco-friendly, solar, EV, or energy-efficient livelihood activity.
SC applicants with family income above ₹5 lakh are ineligible.
Technical vendor authorization or BIS/MNRE certification may be checked by the bank.

name: NSFDC Vocational Training & Start-up Assistance (VTA)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 4% p.a. post-training start-up toolkit loan; skill training tuition is typically 100% grant-funded.
subsidy_margin_note: Training fee + stipend covered by NSFDC grant; start-up equipment loan up to 100% finance.
overview: Combines job-oriented skill development with low-cost start-up tool loans for Scheduled Caste youth aged 18–45. Helps trained artisans, technicians, and service workers buy initial tools and launch self-employment.
key_highlights: 4% p.a. micro start-up loan after completing skill training
Covers toolkits, sewing machines, welding sets, or IT hardware
100% financing option with no upfront margin money hurdle
Priority linkage for PMKVY / ITI / RSETI certificate holders
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Skill training / PMKVY / ITI / RSETI completion certificate
Aadhaar Card and Age Proof (18–45 years)
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Toolkit / equipment vendor quotation and bank passbook
important_notes: Age limit is 18 to 45 years; applicants over 45 should check LVY or PMMY.
Holding an accredited skill certificate significantly accelerates sanction.
Loan ceiling is ₹1,50,000 for post-training self-employment setup.

name: NSFDC Aajeevika Microfinance Yojana (AMFY)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: Up to 12%–16% p.a. when routed via partner NBFC-MFIs (higher than SCA channels due to doorstep servicing).
subsidy_margin_note: 100% collateral-free microfinance with zero margin money; no upfront capital subsidy.
overview: Delivers fast, collateral-free doorstep micro-loans up to ₹60,000 to Scheduled Caste borrowers through empanelled NBFC-MFIs and Joint Liability Groups. Built for rapid working capital turnaround when SCA offices are far away.
key_highlights: Fast doorstep appraisal via NBFC-MFIs and JLG centres
Zero collateral and zero promoter margin money required
Suitable for weekly/monthly petty trade and dairy cashflows
Available across both rural and urban SC clusters
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Aadhaar Card and Voter ID / Ration Card
JLG / SHG group formation & peer guarantee KYC
Family Income Declaration (<= ₹5,00,000)
Bank Passbook for DBT/disbursal
important_notes: Interest rate (~12%+) is notably higher than SCA-routed MCF (5%) or MSY (4%).
Zero moratorium period — repayments usually begin in the first month.
Check if a State Channelising Agency branch is nearby before choosing MFI routing.

name: NSFDC Shilpi Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 5% p.a. concessional interest rate for SC traditional artisans and craftspersons.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 50% subsidy (capped at ₹10,000) under state SCA artisan components alongside concessional loan.
overview: Tailored for Scheduled Caste traditional artisans, leather workers, potters, weavers, and craftspeople needing modern tools and raw materials. Pairs low-interest credit with artisan subsidy support through SCAs.
key_highlights: 5% p.a. interest designed for traditional SC craftspeople
Eligible for up to ₹10,000 capital subsidy via SCA guidelines
3-month moratorium during tool upgrade and raw material purchase
Can be complemented with PM Vishwakarma artisan recognition
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Artisan ID / Craft experience declaration or Vishwakarma ID
Aadhaar Card and Residence Proof
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Raw material / tool quotation and Bank Passbook
important_notes: Maximum project ceiling is ₹50,000; larger craft workshops can consider PM Vishwakarma (up to ₹3L).
Strictly for SC artisans within the ₹5 lakh annual family income limit.
Subsidy component depends on active state SCA budget availability.

name: NSFDC Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY)
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (NSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 6% p.a. concessional interest rate for SC micro-industrial and service units.
subsidy_margin_note: NSFDC finances up to 90% of project cost (max ₹4.50 lakh loan) with 5%–10% promoter margin.
overview: Helps first-generation Scheduled Caste entrepreneurs establish small manufacturing, processing, or service units with up to ₹4.50 lakh in concessional credit. Offers a 6-month gestation period before regular EMIs begin.
key_highlights: Covers 90% of project cost up to ₹4,50,000 loan
6% p.a. fixed concessional interest rate
6-month moratorium for machinery setup and stabilization
Supports first-time SC micro-enterprise founders
required_documents: Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Project Profile / Business Plan and vendor quotations
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Bank Statement / Passbook and premises proof
important_notes: Loan cap is ₹4,50,000; projects above ₹5 lakh should use NSFDC Term Loan.
Open only to SC applicants with family income up to ₹5 lakh.
Requires 10% promoter contribution unless reduced by state SCA margin money.

name: NBCFDC General & New Swarnima Individual Term Loan
agency: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC)
interest_rate_note: 6%–8% p.a. slabbed by loan amount (5% p.a. under New Swarnima for OBC women up to ₹2L).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 85%–95% of project cost financed via SCAs/PSBs; 1% timely repayment rebate where applicable.
overview: Provides concessional term loans up to ₹25 lakh to Other Backward Classes (OBC) entrepreneurs for agriculture, small industry, transport, and services. OBC women qualify for even lower 5% rates under the New Swarnima window.
key_highlights: Up to ₹25,00,000 concessional term credit for OBC applicants
7%–8% p.a. standard rate (5% p.a. New Swarnima for OBC women)
Covers manufacturing, retail, transport, and agri-allied units
6-month moratorium and 5-year standard repayment horizon
required_documents: OBC / OBC-NCL Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Annual Family Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Residence Proof
Project Report and supplier quotations
Bank Passbook and 6-month bank statement
important_notes: Strictly for Backward Classes (OBC) with annual family income up to ₹5,00,000.
State Channelising Agency (SCA) collateral norms apply for loans above ₹1.5–₹2 lakh.
Not available to SC/ST/EWS/General categories — check respective corp or PMMY.

name: NBCFDC Micro Finance / SHG Group Loan
agency: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC)
interest_rate_note: ~7% p.a. through SCAs/Banks; up to ~16% p.a. if disbursed through NBFC-MFIs.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90%–95% group financing (up to ₹25L per SHG, ₹1.25L per member) with minimal margin.
overview: Extends group micro-finance up to ₹25 lakh to Self-Help Groups led by OBC members (including mixed SHGs with majority OBC representation). Supports collective dairy, tailoring, food processing, and village trade.
key_highlights: Up to ₹25,00,000 per SHG (up to ₹1.25L per member)
~7% p.a. via SCAs and PSBs; fast MFI option where needed
Allows mixed SHGs provided majority members are OBC
Collective peer-guarantee model reduces collateral needs
required_documents: OBC Certificates of group members (and majority declaration for mixed SHG)
SHG / JLG registration, resolution, and savings ledger
Family Income Certificates (<= ₹5,00,000 per member)
Aadhaar & KYC of all office bearers
SHG Bank Account Passbook and activity plan
important_notes: MFI channel interest rate can be up to 16% p.a., more than double the 7% SCA/Bank rate.
Designed primarily for OBC and OBC-majority SHG/JLG collectives.
Family income of beneficiary members must not exceed ₹5,00,000 per annum.

name: NMDFC Term Loan & Virasat Self-Employment Scheme
agency: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation (NMDFC)
interest_rate_note: Credit Line-1 (<= ₹3L income): 6% p.a.; Credit Line-2 (<= ₹8L income): 8% p.a. (6% for women).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 85%–90% project funding (10%–15% promoter/SCA share); 5%–6% Mahila Samridhi concessional options.
overview: Supports notified Minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain) to start or expand self-employment businesses up to ₹30 lakh. Includes Virasat special credit for minority artisans and craftspeople.
key_highlights: Higher income ceiling up to ₹8,00,000 under Credit Line-2
Concessional 6% p.a. rate for Credit Line-1 & women borrowers
Loans up to ₹30,00,000 via State Channelising Agencies
Special Virasat support for traditional minority artisans
required_documents: Minority Community Certificate / Self-declaration per state norms
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹3L CL-1 / <= ₹8L CL-2)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Domicile Certificate
Business Project Report and machinery/stock quotations
Bank Passbook and Guarantor / Collateral papers as per SCA
important_notes: Open strictly to notified Minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain).
Applied solely through designated State Channelising Agencies (SCAs) via MILAN portal.
Interest slab depends on whether family income falls in Credit Line-1 (<=₹3L) or Credit Line-2 (<=₹8L).

name: NMDFC Education Loan Scheme
agency: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation (NMDFC)
interest_rate_note: 3% p.a. under Credit Line-1 (income <= ₹3L); 8% male / 5% female under Credit Line-2 (<= ₹8L).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90% of course fees financed (up to ₹20L in India, ₹30L abroad) with long post-course repayment.
overview: Offers highly concessional education loans up to ₹20 lakh in India and ₹30 lakh abroad for students from notified Minority communities. Features a 3%–8% interest slab and repayment starting after course completion.
key_highlights: 3% p.a. rate for families earning <= ₹3L; 5% for women in CL-2
Up to ₹20L for Indian courses and ₹30L for overseas degrees
Covers professional, medical, engineering, and job-oriented diplomas
Repayment holiday during study plus 6–12 months grace
required_documents: Minority Community Certificate / Affidavit
University / College Admission Letter and official fee schedule
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹8,00,000)
Mark sheets of qualifying exams and Aadhaar/Passport
Co-borrower (Parent/Guardian) KYC and Income/Guarantee proof
important_notes: Strictly for notified Minority students; non-minority students should view PM-Vidyalaxmi or NSFDC ELS.
Course must be a recognized job-oriented, technical, or professional programme.
Processed through your state's Minority Finance Corporation (SCA).

name: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme
agency: National Scheduled Tribes Finance & Development Corporation (NSTFDC)
interest_rate_note: 6% p.a. up to ₹5L; 8% p.a. for ₹5L–₹10L; 10% p.a. above ₹10L (4% under Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran up to ₹2L).
subsidy_margin_note: Finances up to 90% of project cost (unit cost up to ₹50L, max loan ₹45L) with 10% promoter/SCA margin.
overview: Provides term loans up to ₹45 lakh for Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals and collectives starting income-generating ventures across farming, forest produce, transport, and small industry. ST women can also access 4% concessional micro-credit.
key_highlights: Up to ₹45,00,000 term financing (90% of ₹50L project cost)
6%–10% p.a. tiered interest; 4% p.a. special rate for ST women
Covers agro-processing, vehicles, shops, and MSMEs
6-month moratorium and 5-year standard repayment
required_documents: Scheduled Tribe (ST) Caste Certificate
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹3,00,000)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Residence Proof
Detailed Project Report (DPR) and machinery/vehicle quotations
Bank Passbook and SCA/Bank guarantor documents
important_notes: Strictly reserved for Scheduled Tribe (ST) applicants.
Official NSTFDC annual family income ceiling is ₹3,00,000 (rural & urban).
Interest rate scales from 6% up to 10% depending on loan amount slab.

name: NSKFDC NAMASTE Mechanised Sanitation Scheme
agency: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC)
interest_rate_note: Concessional 4%–6% p.a. interest via NSKFDC/PSBs alongside massive upfront capital subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 50% capital subsidy (max ₹5,00,000) for sanitation workers/SSWs/waste pickers to buy desludging & sanitation vehicles.
overview: Joint MoSJE-MoHUA mission enabling sanitation workers, sewer/septic tank workers, and waste pickers of all categories to own mechanised cleaning equipment and vehicles safely. Offers up to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹5 lakh) on sanitation machinery.
key_highlights: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹5,00,000 on sanitation machinery
Open to all social categories (occupational sanitation worker focus)
No annual family income cap for NAMASTE beneficiaries
Includes PPE kits, safety training, and Ayushman Bharat linkage
required_documents: NAMASTE / ULB Sanitation Worker or Waste Picker ID / Profiling proof
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Proforma invoice for suction/jetting machine or sanitation vehicle
Driving Licence (if commercial vehicle purchase)
Bank Account Passbook and Municipal/ULB recommendation
important_notes: Applicant or family member must be an identified sanitation worker, SSW, or waste picker.
Subsidy is 50% for projects up to ₹5L (and tiered up to ₹15L) — verify ULB profiling first.
Apply online via JanSamarth, partner banks, or state SCAs.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
agency: Ministry of Finance / MUDRA Ltd. (via JanSamarth & Banks)
interest_rate_note: Market-linked bank MCLR/EBLR (~8.5%–11.5% p.a.; 0.25%–0.50% concession often given to women under Mahila Udyam).
subsidy_margin_note: Zero capital subsidy; collateral-free CGFMU credit guarantee across Shishu (<=₹50K), Kishore (<=₹5L), Tarun (<=₹10L), and Tarun Plus (<=₹20L).
overview: India's flagship collateral-free micro-enterprise loan programme providing up to ₹20 lakh to non-corporate small businesses across trading, manufacturing, services, and allied farm activities. Open to all citizens with no family income cap.
key_highlights: 4 tiers: Shishu (<=₹50K), Kishore (<=₹5L), Tarun (<=₹10L), Tarun Plus (<=₹20L)
100% collateral-free institutional credit backed by CGFMU
Open to all categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General/Minority) with no income ceiling
Fast online in-principle approval via JanSamarth or bank branch
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Voter ID / Passport
Udyam Registration Certificate (free on udyamregistration.gov.in)
Business Address Proof / Shop Rent Agreement
Last 6–12 months Bank Account Statement
Supplier quotations for machinery/equipment and 2 passport photos
important_notes: Tarun Plus (₹10L–₹20L) is strictly for borrowers who successfully repaid an earlier Tarun loan.
PMMY carries no capital subsidy — if you want 15%–35% subsidy, compare with PMEGP.
Interest rates vary across PSBs, private banks, and NBFC-MFIs (~8.5% to 16%+).

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
agency: Ministry of MSME / Khadi & Village Industries Commission (KVIC)
interest_rate_note: Standard bank MSME interest (~9.5%–11.5% p.a.) applies ONLY on net loan after 15%–35% subsidy adjustment.
subsidy_margin_note: 15%–25% (General) and 25%–35% (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minority/PwD/Rural) Margin Money Subsidy; project cap ₹50L manufacturing (max loan ₹47.5L) / ₹20L services.
overview: Central credit-linked subsidy flagship for setting up brand-new micro-enterprises in manufacturing (up to ₹50L project cost, ₹47.5L loan) and services (up to ₹20L). Provides 15% to 35% government grant subsidy kept as a 3-year TDR before permanent adjustment.
key_highlights: Up to 35% Margin Money Subsidy for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Rural units
Max loan up to ₹47,50,000 in manufacturing (₹19L in services)
Only 5% own contribution for special categories (10% General)
Open to all categories with no annual family income ceiling
required_documents: Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the new unit
Caste / Special Category Certificate (for 25%–35% higher subsidy)
Rural Area Certificate (if applying under 25%/35% rural slab)
Educational qualification certificate (8th pass mandatory above ₹10L mfg / ₹5L service)
EDP Training commitment / RSETI certificate and premises proof
important_notes: Strictly for NEW enterprises only — existing units cannot apply (except 2nd expansion loan).
Manufacturing cap is ₹50L project cost (₹47.5L loan), whereas Service/Trading cap is ₹20L.
Mandatory 10-day Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training before subsidy release.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme (SUPI)
agency: Department of Financial Services / SIDBI
interest_rate_note: Capped at Bank Base Rate/MCLR + 3% + tenor premium (~8.25%–9.5% p.a. indicative).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 85% composite loan (up to ₹1 Cr); 15% margin money (can be reduced to 10% by converging state/central subsidy).
overview: Facilitates composite bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore exclusively for SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, trading, or agri-allied sectors. Covers both term loan and working capital with up to 18 months moratorium.
key_highlights: Large greenfield composite loans from ₹10,00,000 to ₹1,00,00,000
Up to 18-month moratorium and 7-year repayment window
Rate capped at MCLR + 3% + tenor premium across all SCBs
Collateral-free coverage available via Credit Guarantee Fund (CGSSI)
required_documents: SC / ST Caste Certificate (or Women ownership proof >= 51% stake)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) for greenfield enterprise
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Address Proof
Machinery / Land / Setup vendor quotations and lease/title deed
12-month Bank Statement and ITR (if applicable)
Non-default declaration on existing loans
important_notes: Strictly for SC/ST borrowers or Women borrowers (>=51% stake) launching a GREENFIELD (first-time) venture.
Minimum loan size is ₹10,00,000; confirm active branch sanction window with your bank before applying.
Note: Scheme sunset/extension circulars vary by financial year — confirm latest bank acceptance.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme (PMV)
agency: Ministry of MSME / Ministry of Skill Development
interest_rate_note: Fixed 5% p.a. beneficiary interest rate (Government provides up to 8% interest subvention to banks).
subsidy_margin_note: Includes ₹15,000 free toolkit e-voucher + ₹500/day training stipend; Tranche-1 up to ₹1L (18m) & Tranche-2 up to ₹2L (30m).
overview: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 notified trades (carpentry, blacksmithing, tailoring, pottery, masonry, cobbler, barber, etc.) with free skill training, a ₹15,000 toolkit grant, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.
key_highlights: Fixed 5% p.a. collateral-free enterprise loan up to ₹3,00,000
₹15,000 toolkit grant + ₹500/day stipend during 5–7 day training
Covers 18 traditional self-employed family-based artisan trades
PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card boosts digital market access
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (linked to mobile for biometric e-KYC at CSC)
Ration Card (family verification — one member per family allowed)
Active Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar seeded for DBT)
Self-declaration of working in one of 18 notified traditional trades
Gram Panchayat / ULB verification status
important_notes: Only one member per family can register, and applicant must work in one of the 18 notified artisan trades.
Tranche 2 (₹2,00,000) unlocks only after repaying Tranche 1 (₹1,00,000) and adopting digital payments.
Government employees and their family members are ineligible.

name: PM SVANidhi Street Vendor Micro-Credit Scheme
agency: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
interest_rate_note: 7% p.a. interest subsidy credited quarterly on timely repayment (net effective cost typically ~2%–5% p.a.).
subsidy_margin_note: 3 progressive collateral-free tranches: ₹15,000 (1st), ₹25,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd) + up to ₹1,200/yr digital cashback.
overview: Provides collateral-free working capital loans in progressive tranches (₹15,000, ₹25,000, and ₹50,000) to urban and peri-urban street vendors. Includes a 7% annual interest subsidy and digital cashback rewards on UPI transactions.
key_highlights: Collateral-free working capital in ₹15K / ₹25K / ₹50K tranches
7% p.a. interest subsidy on regular EMI repayment
Up to ₹1,200/year cashback incentives for accepting UPI
Digital Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation support
required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by ULB
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/TVC if lacking CoV
Aadhaar Card (linked to mobile number)
Voter ID / PAN / Driving Licence
Active Savings Bank Account & UPI QR details
important_notes: Restricted to street vendors operating in urban areas (or surrounding peri-urban/rural areas under ULB).
First-time borrowers start with the ₹10K–₹15K tranche before unlocking ₹25K and ₹50K.
Interest subsidy is forfeited for months with delayed EMI payment.

name: Credit Card for Micro Enterprises (CCME)
agency: Department of Financial Services / JanSamarth (Ministry of MSME)
interest_rate_note: Revolving cash-credit / business credit card facility priced at ~9%–11% p.a. on utilized limit only.
subsidy_margin_note: Customized revolving credit card limit up to ₹5,00,000 for Udyam-registered micro enterprises; collateral-free via CGTMSE.
overview: Dedicated revolving credit card facility up to ₹5 lakh for micro-enterprises registered on the Udyam portal. Allows small business owners to pay suppliers and cover working capital expenses while paying interest only on the amount used.
key_highlights: Up to ₹5,00,000 revolving working capital credit limit
Interest charged only on actual daily utilized balance
Seamless digital onboarding via JanSamarth Udyam verification
Eligible for collateral-free CGTMSE guarantee backing
required_documents: Active Udyam Registration Number (Micro Enterprise category)
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card of proprietor
Last 6–12 months Business / Current Account statement
GST registration / shop establishment proof (if applicable)
Recent ITR or turnover declaration
important_notes: Mandatory requirement: enterprise must hold an active Udyam Registration as a Micro Enterprise.
Designed for working capital expenses, not long-term fixed asset or machinery purchase.
Card limit is sanctioned based on business turnover and bank credit score.

name: JanSamarth Loan for Startups (CGSS)
agency: DPIIT / National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC)
interest_rate_note: Commercial bank/NBFC lending rate (~9.5%–12% p.a.) backed by Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS up to ₹10 Cr).
subsidy_margin_note: Collateral-free credit guarantee up to ₹10 Crore per borrower via NCGTC (1%–2% annual guarantee fee; 1% concession for women/NER).
overview: Enables DPIIT-recognized startups to raise collateral-free term loans, working capital, or venture debt from scheduled banks and financial institutions through the JanSamarth portal. Backed by the Central Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups (CGSS).
key_highlights: No upper loan cap (credit guarantee available up to ₹10 Crore)
Collateral-free institutional debt for DPIIT-recognized startups
12-month typical moratorium aligned with product scaling
Digital matching with multiple banks via JanSamarth
required_documents: DPIIT Startup India Recognition Certificate
Certificate of Incorporation / LLP / Partnership Deed
Audited Financials / Projected Cash Flows & Pitch Deck
Founders' Aadhaar, PAN, and Bank Statements (12 months)
GST / Udyam Registration and commercial traction proof
important_notes: Strictly requires valid DPIIT Startup Recognition — traditional kirana/shops should apply under PMMY or PMEGP.
No capital subsidy; borrowers pay commercial interest plus annual NCGTC guarantee fee.
Minimum 12 months of stable revenue or strong venture backing improves bank sanction.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
agency: Ministry of MSME & SIDBI (CGTMSE Trust)
interest_rate_note: Bank MSME lending rate (~9%–11.5% p.a.) + annual guarantee fee (~0.37%–1.35% p.a.; 10% fee concession for Women/SC/ST/PwD).
subsidy_margin_note: 75%–85% credit guarantee cover without third-party collateral up to ₹10 Crore (hybrid security allowed above ₹5 Cr).
overview: Allows new and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) to obtain collateral-free term loans and working capital up to ₹10 crore from banks and NBFCs. Eliminates land or property mortgage hurdles for growing MSMEs.
key_highlights: Collateral-free guarantee backing up to ₹10 Crore per unit
85% guarantee cover for micro enterprises, women, and SC/ST MSEs
10% reduction in guarantee fee for Women/SC/ST/PwD/Agniveer
Covers both Term Loans and Working Capital facilities
required_documents: Udyam Registration Certificate (Micro or Small Enterprise)
PAN, Aadhaar, and KYC of proprietor/partners/directors
Detailed Project Report & 2-year financial statements / ITR
12 months Bank Statement and GST returns (if registered)
Machinery quotations / Commercial lease agreement
important_notes: CGTMSE is a guarantee mechanism operated through banks — you do not apply directly to CGTMSE Trust.
Annual guarantee fee is charged over and above the bank's interest rate.
No upfront capital subsidy; combine with PMEGP or state subsidies if eligible.

name: PM-Vidyalaxmi Higher Education Loan Scheme
agency: Ministry of Education / Department of Higher Education
interest_rate_note: Bank education rate (~8.1%–9.5% p.a.) with 3% interest subvention (<= ₹8L income) or 100% moratorium subvention (<= ₹4.5L income via PM-USP CSIS).
subsidy_margin_note: Collateral-free & guarantor-free loans + 75% credit guarantee up to ₹7.5L + 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10L.
overview: Guarantees collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans for meritorious students admitted to India's top 860 Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs). Families earning up to ₹8 lakh receive a 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10 lakh during moratorium.
key_highlights: 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹10L for income <= ₹8L
100% collateral-free and guarantor-free across top 860 QHEIs
75% Government Credit Guarantee for loans up to ₹7.5 lakh
Single unified digital portal connected to all major banks
required_documents: Admission Letter from one of the 860 notified QHEIs (NIRF top institutions)
Official Course Fee & Hostel Expense Structure
Annual Family Income Certificate (<= ₹8,00,000 for 3% subvention)
Student & Parent Aadhaar, PAN, and Academic Marksheets
Student Savings Bank Account details for DBT subvention e-voucher
important_notes: Interest subvention and credit guarantee apply specifically to admissions in the 860 notified QHEIs.
Income ceiling for 3% subvention is ₹8,00,000 (and ₹4,50,000 for full CSIS interest subvention).
SC/Minority students may compare with NSFDC ELS (4%) or NMDFC (3%–5%) for even lower base rates.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
agency: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
interest_rate_note: Standard bank term loan interest (~9%–11% p.a.) applied on project loan net of 35% credit-linked capital subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10,00,000 per micro food processing unit (only 10% beneficiary contribution).
overview: Supports micro food processing units (spice mills, dairy, bakery, pickle/papad, oil expellers, fruit processing) with a 35% credit-linked capital subsidy capped at ₹10 lakh. Also supports SHGs with ₹40,000/member seed capital and branding support.
key_highlights: Flat 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to ₹10,00,000
Available for both new units (ODOP focus) and existing upgrades
Only 10% own contribution required from the entrepreneur
Includes free District Resource Person (DRP) DPR handholding
required_documents: Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Detailed Project Report (DPR) for food processing unit
FSSAI Registration / Food Business proof (or application)
Udyam Registration and Machinery Quotations
12-month Bank Statement and Premises Proof
important_notes: Strictly for food processing, packaging, grading, or value-added agro-food units.
Subsidy is capped at ₹10 lakh even if total project cost exceeds ₹28.57 lakh.
One District One Product (ODOP) priority items receive faster district-committee clearance.

name: PMAY-Urban 2.0 Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS)
agency: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / NHB / HUDCO
interest_rate_note: Bank/HFC home loan rate (~8.4%–9.5% p.a.) with 4% interest subsidy on first ₹8 lakh loan principal.
subsidy_margin_note: 4% interest subsidy on first ₹8,00,000 of home loan (max benefit ₹1,80,000 released in 5 yearly instalments of ₹36,000).
overview: Helps urban EWS, LIG, and MIG families (income up to ₹9 lakh) buy or build their first pucca home with a 4% interest subsidy on the first ₹8 lakh of a housing loan. Maximum total subsidy of ₹1.80 lakh is credited in five annual instalments.
key_highlights: 4% interest subsidy on first ₹8,00,000 (up to ₹1,80,000 total benefit)
Eligible for urban EWS (<=₹3L), LIG (<=₹6L), and MIG (<=₹9L)
Covers house purchase, construction, or repurchase up to ₹35L value
Women ownership or co-ownership strongly encouraged
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members (no prior pucca house across India)
Annual Family Income Proof (<= ₹9,00,000)
Sale Agreement / Construction Plan (house value <= ₹35L, loan <= ₹25L)
Bank / Housing Finance Company (HFC) Home Loan Sanction Letter
Active Bank Account linked to Aadhaar for DBT subsidy credits
important_notes: Strictly a HOUSING loan subsidy — cannot be used for commercial or business enterprises.
Property value must not exceed ₹35 lakh and maximum eligible loan is ₹25 lakh.
Subsidy is disbursed in 5 yearly tranches only while the home loan remains active and standard.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana Solar Loan
agency: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy (MNRE) / REC
interest_rate_note: Repo + 0.5% (~6.75%–7% p.a.) collateral-free up to ₹2L (up to 3 kW); ~8.15% p.a. for 3–10 kW systems up to ₹6L.
subsidy_margin_note: Central CFA subsidy: ₹30,000 (1 kW), ₹60,000 (2 kW), ₹78,000 (3 kW+) credited directly after commissioning.
overview: Offers low-interest bank loans up to ₹6 lakh and direct capital subsidies up to ₹78,000 for installing residential rooftop solar panels. Loans up to ₹2 lakh (for systems up to 3 kW) are completely collateral-free at concessional ~6.75%–7% interest.
key_highlights: Up to ₹78,000 direct central subsidy credited to bank account
Collateral-free ~6.75%–7% loan for systems up to 3 kW (<= ₹2L)
10-year (120-month) tenure with 6-month installation moratorium
Zero monthly electricity bills up to 300 free units/month
required_documents: Latest Residential Electricity Bill (in applicant/family name)
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Roof Ownership / Property Tax / Sale Deed proof
MNRE Empanelled Vendor Quotation for DCR solar panels
Bank Passbook / Cancelled Cheque for subsidy DBT
important_notes: Applicable only for residential rooftop solar installations (not commercial factories).
Must use MNRE-approved DCR (Domestically Manufactured) solar panels and empanelled vendors.
Subsidy is capped at ₹78,000 for 3 kW and above; loans >₹2L carry ~8.15% interest and 10% margin.

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Agriculture Pump & Feeder Loan
agency: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy (MNRE) & State Nodal Agencies
interest_rate_note: AIF/Bank agri term loan rate (~8.5%–9.5% p.a.; eligible for 3% AIF interest subvention for solarised grid/community setups).
subsidy_margin_note: 60% combined Central (30%) + State (30%) capital subsidy; 30% bank loan; only 10% farmer contribution.
overview: Helps farmers replace diesel irrigation pumps with standalone solar pumps (Component B) or solarise existing grid pumps (Component C) with 60% Central+State capital subsidy. Farmers arrange only 10% upfront cash and finance 30% through low-cost bank credit.
key_highlights: 60% combined Government subsidy (30% Central + 30% State)
Only 10% farmer upfront share; 30% covered by bank loan
Eliminates recurring diesel costs and daytime power cuts
Surplus solar power can be sold to DISCOM under Component C
required_documents: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni / 7-12 Extract / Jamabandi)
Aadhaar Card and Farmer Registration ID
Water source / borewell feasibility declaration
Existing agricultural electricity connection bill (for Component C)
Bank Account Passbook & State Nodal Portal acknowledgement
important_notes: Restricted strictly to farmers with agricultural land and valid irrigation source.
State tender cycles open periodically on each state's Renewable Energy Nodal Portal.
Pump capacity eligibility typically spans 2 HP to 10 HP (subsidy up to 7.5 HP standard).

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) — Crop & Working Capital Loan
agency: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / NABARD
interest_rate_note: 7% p.a. concessional crop loan up to ₹3 lakh; 3% prompt repayment incentive lowers effective rate to 4% p.a.
subsidy_margin_note: 2%–1.5% Modified Interest Subvention + 3% Prompt Repayment Incentive = effective 4% p.a. up to ₹3,00,000; collateral-free up to ₹2,00,000 (RBI revised).
overview: Provides short-term revolving credit to farmers, sharecroppers, and tenant farmers for seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and post-harvest expenses. Timely repayment lowers the effective interest rate to just 4% per annum up to ₹3 lakh.
key_highlights: Effective 4% p.a. interest with timely repayment (up to ₹3L)
Collateral-free crop limit up to ₹2,00,000 (revised RBI limit)
RuPay KCC ATM card for instant seasonal input purchases
Includes PMFBY crop insurance linkage against crop loss
required_documents: Cultivable Land Records (ROR / Khasra-Khatauni) or Tenant/JLG Agreement
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Passport-size Photographs (2)
Existing Bank Passbook (for DBT interest subvention)
Cropping pattern declaration
important_notes: 4% effective rate applies only up to ₹3,00,000 and only if repaid within 12 months / due date.
Purely for cultivation, crop inputs, and allied working capital — not non-farm shops.
Sanctioned limit is computed using district Scale of Finance x acreage.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) — Fisheries & Animal Husbandry
agency: Department of Fisheries / Ministry of Fisheries, AH & Dairying
interest_rate_note: 7% p.a. base rate; 3% prompt repayment incentive brings effective interest down to 4% p.a. up to ₹2 lakh.
subsidy_margin_note: Interest subvention up to ₹2,00,000 (or ₹3L combined with crop KCC) giving 4% net effective interest on timely repayment.
overview: Extends KCC working capital credit up to ₹2 lakh at an effective 4% interest rate to inland and marine fishers, fish farmers, SHGs, and dairy/poultry operators. Covers fingerlings, fish feed, pond lease, boat fuel, and ice/net maintenance.
key_highlights: Effective 4% p.a. interest on prompt repayment up to ₹2,00,000
Collateral-free facility for eligible individual fishers & SHGs
Covers fish seed, feed, nets, boat repair, and pond inputs
Digital application enabled through JanSamarth portal
required_documents: Fisher / Fish Farmer ID Card or Fishing Licence / Pond Lease Deed
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
SHG / Cooperative Society resolution (if applying as group)
Bank Account Passbook and 2 passport photographs
Working capital cost estimate
important_notes: Interest subvention for standalone Fisheries/AH KCC is capped at ₹2,00,000 (₹3L combined with crop KCC).
Must hold valid fishing licence, pond ownership, or registered lease agreement.
Capital equipment like new boats/ponds are better financed under PMMSY or AIF.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
agency: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
interest_rate_note: Lending rate capped at 9% p.a. minus 3% Central Interest Subvention = effective 6% p.a. up to ₹2 Crore for 7 years.
subsidy_margin_note: 3% p.a. interest subvention up to ₹2 Crore for 7 years + CGTMSE credit guarantee fee reimbursement + convergence with PMFME/PM-KUSUM.
overview: Medium-to-long-term debt financing facility for post-harvest agricultural infrastructure such as cold storages, warehouses, grading/sorting units, ripening chambers, and primary processing centres. Guarantees 3% interest subvention up to ₹2 crore for up to 7 years.
key_highlights: 3% p.a. interest subvention up to ₹2 Crore (net rate ~6% p.a.)
CGTMSE collateral-free guarantee fee paid by Government up to ₹2 Cr
Can be converged with capital subsidies (PMFME, MIDH, SMAM)
Flexible 6–24 month moratorium during facility construction
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) for post-harvest / agri-infra asset
Land ownership or registered long-term lease agreement
Aadhaar, PAN, and FPO/SHG/Firm registration documents
Machinery & civil construction cost estimates
12 months Bank Statement and financial projections
important_notes: Strictly for post-harvest infrastructure or community farming assets (not land purchase or working capital).
Interest subvention applies for a maximum of 7 years and up to ₹2 crore loan.
Minimum 10% promoter contribution is standard unless converged with state subsidies.

name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres Scheme (ACABC)
agency: Ministry of Agriculture / MANAGE & NABARD
interest_rate_note: Commercial bank agri-term loan rate (~9%–11% p.a.) applied on loan portion alongside 36%–44% composite capital subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: 44% composite subsidy for Women, SC, ST & NER/Hill states (36% for all others) on project cost up to ₹20L individual / ₹1 Cr group.
overview: Empowers agriculture, veterinary, dairy, fisheries, and allied science graduates to establish soil testing labs, veterinary clinics, agri-input centres, and custom hiring hubs. Offers 44% capital subsidy for SC/ST/Women and 36% for others after free residential training.
key_highlights: 44% subsidy for SC/ST/Women (36% for General) via NABARD
Individual project cap up to ₹20,00,000 (₹1 Cr for 5-member group)
Free 45-day residential training via MANAGE Nodal Training Institutes
Collateral-free bank loan norms up to ₹5 lakh
required_documents: Agriculture / Allied Degree, Diploma, or 12th Agri Certificate
MANAGE / ACABC Nodal Training Institute completion certificate
Caste / Women Certificate (for 44% subsidy slab)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Premises lease/ownership & equipment quotations
important_notes: Strictly restricted to qualified Agriculture/Veterinary/Dairy/Allied graduates or diploma holders.
45-day residential ACABC training at a MANAGE NTI is mandatory prior to subsidy sanction.
Subsidy is back-ended in a Subsidy Reserve Fund Account with a 3-year lock-in.

name: e-Kisan Upaj Nidhi (WDRA e-NWR Pledge Loan)
agency: Ministry of Consumer Affairs / WDRA
interest_rate_note: 7% p.a. interest rate (effective 4% p.a. with 3% prompt repayment subvention for KCC-holding small/marginal farmers).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 75%–80% of stored commodity value advanced digitally against e-NWR with 0% security deposit at WDRA warehouses.
overview: Helps farmers avoid distress selling at harvest by letting them store produce in WDRA-registered warehouses and get instant online pledge loans against electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipts (e-NWR). Small farmers with KCC receive interest subvention down to 4%.
key_highlights: Instant digital pledge loan up to ₹7,50,000 against stored crop
Prevents post-harvest distress sales when market prices are low
4% effective interest for prompt-paying KCC small/marginal farmers
Zero additional collateral — the stored produce e-NWR is security
required_documents: Electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipt (e-NWR) from WDRA warehouse
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Kisan Credit Card (KCC) details (for interest subvention benefit)
Land / Crop cultivation proof and Bank Passbook
important_notes: Crop must be stored in a WDRA-registered warehouse issuing digital e-NWR receipts.
Short-term pledge tenure (typically up to 6 months, matching commodity shelf life).
Warehouse rental and insurance charges are borne separately by the farmer.

name: Skill Loan Scheme (CGFSSD)
agency: Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship / NCGTC
interest_rate_note: Capped at Bank EBLR/MCLR + 1.50% p.a. (~8.5%–10% p.a. indicative) across all scheduled banks and NBFCs.
subsidy_margin_note: 100% collateral-free and third-party guarantor-free loan from ₹5,000 to ₹7,50,000 backed by 75% NCGTC CGFSSD guarantee.
overview: Provides collateral-free and guarantor-free skill loans from ₹5,000 up to ₹7.50 lakh for youth enrolled in NSQF-aligned courses at ITIs, polytechnics, or NSDC-affiliated training partners. Repayment starts only after course completion plus a moratorium period.
key_highlights: Up to ₹7,50,000 collateral-free (raised from ₹1.5L in 2024)
Interest rate capped at MCLR/EBLR + 1.50% across participating banks
Covers tuition, exam, assessment, and hostel/equipment fees
Repayment tenure 3 to 7 years after course + 6m moratorium
required_documents: Admission Letter for NSQF-aligned course at ITI / Polytechnic / NSDC partner
Official Fee Structure issued by training institute
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Previous Academic Certificates
Bank Account Passbook (student/co-applicant)
important_notes: Course must be NSQF-aligned and offered by NSDC, Sector Skill Councils, ITIs, or State Skill Missions.
No upfront capital subsidy; this is a pure concessional skill financing loan.
SC/Minority students may compare with NSFDC VTA (4%) or NMDFC schemes.

name: DAY-NRLM Women SHG Livelihood Credit
agency: Ministry of Rural Development (Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana)
interest_rate_note: 7% p.a. universal interest rate up to ₹3L for Women SHGs; 3% additional prompt repayment subvention in select districts (effective 4%).
subsidy_margin_note: Collateral-free SHG credit linkage up to ₹20L (with 7% interest subvention on first ₹3L per SHG + Revolving Fund grants).
overview: Connects rural women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) under State Rural Livelihood Missions to collateral-free bank credit at a subsidized 7% per annum interest rate up to ₹3 lakh. Empowers Lakhpati Didi collectives in dairy, tailoring, food, and retail.
key_highlights: 7% p.a. subsidized interest up to ₹3,00,000 (4% in select districts)
Collateral-free bank linkage through NRLM SHG grading
Zero margin money required for active Panchasutra SHGs
Direct online submission through JanSamarth NRLM portal
required_documents: NRLM / SRLM SHG Registration & LokOS / NRLM MIS ID
SHG Meeting Resolution & Savings/Internal Lending Ledger
Aadhaar & KYC of SHG President, Secretary & Treasurer
SHG Bank Passbook (6 months Panchasutra track record)
Micro Credit Plan (MCP) approved by Village Organisation
important_notes: Exclusively for women members organized into active NRLM-registered rural SHGs.
7% interest subvention covers up to ₹3,00,000; higher SHG loans carry bank commercial rates.
SHG must be at least 6 months old following Panchasutra norms.

name: DAY-NULM Self-Employment Programme (SEP)
agency: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA) & Urban Local Bodies
interest_rate_note: Interest subvention reimburses the difference above 7% p.a. (so borrower's effective interest is capped at 7% p.a., or 4% for timely women SHGs).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to ₹2,00,000 for individual micro-enterprises and up to ₹10,00,000 for group enterprises; zero collateral required.
overview: Helps urban poor individuals and self-help groups set up small shops, workshops, or service businesses with subsidized bank loans at an effective 7% interest rate. Offers up to ₹2 lakh for individuals and ₹10 lakh for group ventures.
key_highlights: Effective 7% p.a. interest via automatic bank subvention
Individual cap ₹2,00,000; Group Enterprise cap ₹10,00,000
Extra 3% rebate (effective 4% rate) for timely Women SHG groups
Collateral-free sanction routed via ULB & JanSamarth
required_documents: Urban Residence Proof / Municipal Ward Verification
BPL / Urban Poor / SECC or Income Certificate per ULB norms
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Bank Passbook
Project Proposal / Vendor Quote and ULB Task Force recommendation
Group Registration / Resolution (for SEP-G group loans)
important_notes: Applies strictly to urban poor residents under statutory Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
Individual applicants are capped at ₹2,00,000 (only Group Enterprises reach ₹10,00,000).
Applications are screened by the Urban Local Body before bank forwarding.

name: Weaver MUDRA Scheme (Handloom Concessional Credit)
agency: Ministry of Textiles (Office of Development Commissioner Handlooms)
interest_rate_note: Concessional 6% p.a. effective interest rate to handloom weavers (up to 7% GoI interest subvention for 3 years).
subsidy_margin_note: 20% margin money assistance up to ₹25,000 per weaver + 6% interest subvention for 3 years + CGTMSE guarantee.
overview: Provides affordable working capital and loom-upgrade credit up to ₹5 lakh at a fixed 6% interest rate for handloom weavers across India. Includes 20% margin money grant support up to ₹25,000 directly into the weaver's loan account.
key_highlights: Concessional 6% p.a. interest rate for up to 3 years
20% government margin money support up to ₹25,000
Collateral-free credit backing via Weaver Mudra Portal & JanSamarth
Covers yarn purchase, jacquard/dobby upgrades, and looms
required_documents: Pehchan Handloom Weaver ID Card issued by Ministry of Textiles
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar seeded)
Yarn / Loom Equipment Quotations
Handloom Cooperative / Cluster recommendation (if applicable)
important_notes: Applicant must be a verified handloom weaver holding a Pehchan Weaver ID Card.
Margin money assistance is capped at ₹25,000 (i.e., 20% on ₹1.25L+ project cost).
Interest subvention to 6% applies for the first 3 years of the credit facility.

name: National Livestock Mission — Entrepreneurship Development (NLM-EDP)
agency: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying (DAHD)
interest_rate_note: Standard bank agri/MSME term loan rate (~9%–11% p.a.) on the non-subsidy loan component.
subsidy_margin_note: Flat 50% one-time capital subsidy up to ₹50,00,000 (on ₹1 Cr max project) for poultry, sheep/goat, piggery, and fodder units.
overview: Offers a massive 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹50 lakh) for rural entrepreneurs, FPOs, and SHGs establishing commercial poultry hatcheries, sheep/goat breeding farms, piggery, or fodder processing units. Combines bank loans with direct SIDBI-monitored central subsidy.
key_highlights: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹50,00,000 (project size up to ₹1 Cr)
Covers goat/sheep breeding, rural poultry, piggery & silage
Open to individuals, SHGs, FPOs, and Section 8 companies
6–12 month gestation period until livestock production starts
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) per NLM model template
Land ownership or minimum 5–10 year registered lease deed
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Address Proof
Livestock training / experience certificate & Geo-tagged site photos
Bank sanction consent & 10%–25% promoter equity proof
important_notes: Dairy cattle/buffalo farming is NOT covered under NLM-EDP (only goat, sheep, poultry, piggery, horse/camel/donkey, and feed/fodder).
Subsidy is released in two instalments (50% after bank loan release, 50% after project completion).
Requires valid land title or registered long-term lease.

name: Rajasthan Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Dalit Adivasi Udyam Protsahan Yojana (BRUPY)
agency: Industries & Commerce Department, Government of Rajasthan
interest_rate_note: 9% interest subsidy (< ₹25L), 7% (< ₹5 Cr), or 6% (<= ₹10 Cr) brings net effective rate down to ~1%–4% p.a.
subsidy_margin_note: 25% capital margin money grant up to ₹25,00,000 + 6%–9% interest subsidy + RIICO land rebate & stamp duty exemption.
overview: Rajasthan's flagship entrepreneurship incentive scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe founders starting manufacturing, service, or trading enterprises. Combines a 25% margin money grant (up to ₹25 lakh) with up to 9% interest subsidy.
key_highlights: 25% margin money grant up to ₹25,00,000 for SC/ST founders
6% to 9% interest subsidy lowers borrowing cost to ~2%–4%
RIICO industrial plot concession & 100% stamp duty exemption
No annual family income limit for Rajasthan SC/ST applicants
required_documents: Rajasthan Jan Aadhaar Card & SSO ID
Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) Certificate
Rajasthan Domicile (Bonafide Resident) Certificate
Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Udyam Registration
Aadhaar, PAN, and Bank Sanction / Loan Application papers
important_notes: Strictly restricted to bona fide SC and ST residents establishing units in Rajasthan.
Trading sector loans are typically capped at ₹1 Crore, whereas manufacturing/services go higher.
Apply online via Rajasthan SSO / BRUPY portal before final bank disbursement.

name: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Laghu Udyog Protsahan Yojana (MLUPY)
agency: Department of Industries & Commerce, Government of Rajasthan
interest_rate_note: Interest subsidy of 8% (loans <= ₹25L), 6% (<= ₹5 Cr), and 5% (<= ₹10 Cr) reduces net rate to ~2%–5% p.a.
subsidy_margin_note: 5%–8% interest subsidy on term/composite loans up to ₹10 Crore (no capital grant; pair with CGTMSE for collateral cover).
overview: Provides heavy interest subsidies (5% to 8%) on bank loans up to ₹10 crore for setting up or expanding MSMEs across Rajasthan. Open to entrepreneurs of all categories with zero income ceiling.
key_highlights: 8% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹25L (net rate often < 3%)
Covers new setups, expansion, and modernization up to ₹10 Crore
Open to all categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General/Minority) in Rajasthan
End-to-end digital tracking via Rajasthan SSO Portal
required_documents: Rajasthan SSO ID & Jan Aadhaar / Aadhaar Card
Rajasthan Domicile / Enterprise Location Proof
Udyam Registration and Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Machinery / Equipment Vendor Quotations
PAN Card and 12-month Bank Statement
important_notes: Enterprise must be physically located in Rajasthan; out-of-state units are ineligible.
Trading sector eligibility is capped at ₹1 Crore, while manufacturing/service reach ₹10 Crore.
SC/ST applicants in Rajasthan may get even better capital grant terms under BRUPY.

name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan (CM-YUVA)
agency: MSME & Export Promotion Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
interest_rate_note: 100% Interest-Free loan (0% effective interest for 4 years) + CGTMSE collateral-free coverage.
subsidy_margin_note: 10% Margin Money Capital Grant (only 5%–10% own contribution; 0% interest for 4 years; 2nd tranche up to ₹10L on timely repayment).
overview: Uttar Pradesh's youth entrepreneurship mission offering collateral-free, 100% interest-free loans up to ₹5 lakh along with a 10% margin money grant. Open to educated and skill-trained youth aged 21–40 across all social categories in UP.
key_highlights: 0% interest (100% interest-free for 4 years) up to ₹5,00,000
10% upfront Margin Money Grant reduces total repayment burden
100% collateral-free via CGTMSE guarantee paid by UP Govt
Unlocks a second ₹10,00,000 loan upon timely first-loan repayment
required_documents: Uttar Pradesh Domicile / Residence Certificate
Aadhaar Card & PAN Card (Age 21–40 years)
Educational Certificate (min 8th pass) + Skill Training Certificate (ODOP/PMKVY/ITI/RSETI)
Project Report & Equipment Quotations
Bank Passbook and Non-defaulter Affidavit
important_notes: Strictly for Uttar Pradesh residents aged 21 to 40 years (check age cutoff carefully).
Must hold an accredited skill training certificate (e.g., ODOP, Vishwakarma, ITI, PMKVY, or RSETI).
Zero interest applies for the 4-year loan tenure; timely repayment unlocks a 2nd ₹10L phase.

name: Uttar Pradesh ODOP Margin Money Scheme
agency: Directorate of Industries, Government of Uttar Pradesh
interest_rate_note: Standard bank MSME interest (~8.5%–10.5% p.a.) applied on loan balance after 10%–25% ODOP margin money subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: 25% subsidy up to ₹25L project (max ₹6.25L), 20% for ₹25L–₹50L (max ₹10L), and 10% above ₹50L (max ₹20L).
overview: Finances entrepreneurs in Uttar Pradesh launching or expanding units aligned with their district's notified One District One Product (ODOP) craft or industry. Provides 10% to 25% margin money subsidy up to ₹20 lakh alongside bank credit.
key_highlights: 10%–25% capital margin money subsidy (capped at ₹20,00,000)
Open to all categories in UP with no family income limit
Only 10% beneficiary own contribution required
Supports brassware, chikankari, leather, food, pottery & 75 district crafts
required_documents: Uttar Pradesh Domicile & Aadhaar / PAN Card
Project Report aligned with district's notified ODOP product
Machinery & Raw Material Quotations
Udyam Registration & Premises Ownership/Rent Deed
Bank Account Statement & Affidavit of no prior subsidy
important_notes: Enterprise activity MUST match the official ODOP product notified for your UP district.
Subsidy is locked in TDR for 2–3 years before final adjustment against the loan.
Cannot combine margin money subsidy with PMEGP on the exact same project.

name: Tamil Nadu Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS)
agency: MSME Department / TAHDCO & DIC, Government of Tamil Nadu
interest_rate_note: 6% interest subvention on bank term loans reduces effective borrowing cost to ~3.5%–5.5% p.a.
subsidy_margin_note: 35% capital subsidy on plant & machinery (up to ₹1.50 Crore) + 6% interest subvention + 100% stamp duty reimbursement.
overview: Tamil Nadu's landmark industrial promotion scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs starting new enterprises or expanding existing units. Provides an unmatched 35% capital subsidy up to ₹1.50 crore plus 6% interest subvention.
key_highlights: 35% capital subsidy up to ₹1,50,00,000 on project machinery/assets
6% interest subvention over entire term loan repayment
No annual family income ceiling for Tamil Nadu SC/ST founders
Includes commercial transport vehicles & industrial equipment
required_documents: Tamil Nadu Community Certificate (SC / ST)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Tamil Nadu Domicile Proof
Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Udyam Registration
Plant/Machinery/Commercial Vehicle Quotations
100% SC/ST ownership partnership deed / incorporation papers
important_notes: Strictly for SC/ST entrepreneurs (100% SC/ST shareholding) establishing enterprises in Tamil Nadu.
Age limit is 18 to 55 years (no upper age cap for expansion of existing units).
Cannot be clubbed with NEEDS or PMEGP capital subsidy on the same assets.

name: Tamil Nadu New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
agency: Department of Industries & Commerce (DIC), Government of Tamil Nadu
interest_rate_note: Bank MSME rate minus 3% state interest subvention = ~6.5%–7.5% p.a. effective rate.
subsidy_margin_note: 25% capital subsidy (max ₹75,00,000) + 3% interest subvention on term loan (5% promoter contribution for Special Category).
overview: Grooms educated first-generation youth in Tamil Nadu (degree, diploma, ITI, or vocational graduates) to set up manufacturing or service enterprises between ₹10 lakh and ₹5 crore. Provides 25% project subsidy up to ₹75 lakh and 3% interest subvention.
key_highlights: 25% capital subsidy up to ₹75,00,000 on project cost up to ₹5 Cr
3% interest subvention for entire term loan repayment period
Only 5% promoter margin for SC/ST/BC/MBC/Minority/Women (10% General)
Includes mandatory 1-month EDII entrepreneurship training
required_documents: Degree / Diploma / ITI / Recognized Vocational Certificate
Tamil Nadu Residence Proof (min 3 years) & Aadhaar/PAN
Detailed Project Report (DPR) for ₹10L–₹5 Cr unit
Community Certificate (for special category 5% margin & age 45)
Machinery Quotations and Factory/Office Lease Agreement
important_notes: Strictly for first-generation educated entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu (min project ₹10 lakh).
Age limit: 21–35 (General) and 21–45 (Special Category including Women/SC/ST/BC/MBC).
Trading businesses are NOT eligible under NEEDS — only manufacturing and eligible services.

name: Bihar Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (MMUY)
agency: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar
interest_rate_note: 0% interest for Women/SC/ST and 1% simple interest for Youth/EBC/Minority on the 50% loan portion (84 monthly instalments).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to ₹10,00,000 total funding: 50% (max ₹5,00,000) is an outright non-refundable Govt Grant + 50% (max ₹5,00,000) is 0%–1% loan.
overview: Bihar's flagship self-employment scheme providing up to ₹10 lakh directly from the State Industries Department without requiring bank approval. Half the amount (up to ₹5 lakh) is an outright grant and the remaining half is a 0%–1% soft loan repaid over 7 years.
key_highlights: 50% outright Government Grant (up to ₹5,00,000 non-refundable)
Remaining 50% loan at 0% (SC/ST/Women) or 1% (Yuva/EBC/Minority)
Direct state-portal selection — no bank collateral required
1-year initial moratorium + 84 easy monthly instalments
required_documents: Bihar Permanent Residence (Domicile) Certificate
10th, 12th / ITI / Polytechnic / Diploma Certificate (min 10+2)
Caste Certificate (SC/ST/BC/EBC) & Aadhaar/PAN Card
Current Bank Account in firm's name (required post-selection)
Passport-size photo and signature specimen
important_notes: Strictly for permanent residents of Bihar aged 18–50 with minimum 10+2 / ITI / Diploma qualification.
Selection happens via computerized lottery during annual application windows on udyami.bihar.gov.in.
Only notified manufacturing and service activities in Bihar's approved project list are funded.

name: Maharashtra Chief Minister's Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)
agency: Directorate of Industries & KVIB, Government of Maharashtra
interest_rate_note: Standard bank MSME interest (~9.5%–11.5% p.a.) calculated on loan net of 15%–35% state margin subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: 15%–25% (Open) and 25%–35% (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minority/Rural) State Subsidy; max project ₹50L mfg (₹47.5L loan) / ₹20L service.
overview: Maharashtra's credit-linked subsidy scheme empowering youth and entrepreneurs to start new manufacturing, service, or agro-based enterprises up to ₹50 lakh. Delivers 15% to 35% state government margin money subsidy with only 5%–10% own contribution.
key_highlights: Up to 35% state subsidy for SC/ST/Women/OBC/Rural projects
Max loan ₹47,50,000 for manufacturing (₹19L for service/agro)
Only 5% own margin required for special category applicants
3-year subsidy lock-in adjusts directly into loan principal
required_documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate / 15-year Residence Proof
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Birth/Age Proof (18–45/50 yrs)
Caste / Special Category Certificate (for 25%–35% higher subsidy)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Machinery Quotations
Educational Certificate (7th pass >₹10L / 10th pass >₹25L)
important_notes: Strictly for new enterprises established within Maharashtra by state residents.
Age limit is 18–45 years (relaxed to 50 years for SC/ST/Women/PwD/Ex-servicemen).
Cannot avail CMEGP if you or spouse already took PMEGP or central subsidy.

name: Gujarat Shri Vajpayee Bankable Yojana (VBY)
agency: Commissioner of Cottage and Rural Industries, Government of Gujarat
interest_rate_note: Standard bank MSME loan interest (~8.5%–10.5% p.a.) applied on balance after 20%–40% Gujarat state capital subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: Subsidy up to ₹1,25,000 (25%–40% based on rural/urban & SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD category) on bank loans up to ₹8 lakh.
overview: Gujarat's bank-linked self-employment scheme supporting rural and urban artisans, technicians, and small traders with loans up to ₹8 lakh. State government provides 20% to 40% back-ended capital subsidy (up to ₹1.25 lakh) directly through District Industries Centres.
key_highlights: Up to 40% capital subsidy (max ₹1,25,000) for SC/ST/Women/PwD
No annual family income limit for Gujarat applicants
Covers industry, service, and small business/trade up to ₹8L
Fast online filing via Gujarat Bankable Loan Portal (BLP)
required_documents: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
Gujarat Residence Proof (3+ years ration/domicile/light bill)
Educational Qualification (min 4th pass) or 1-yr trade experience
Caste / Disability Certificate (for enhanced subsidy slab)
Project Report & Equipment Vendor Quotations
important_notes: Strictly for Gujarat residents aged 18–65 setting up units inside Gujarat.
Maximum subsidy cap is ₹1,25,000 (₹1,00,000 for trading/service in urban general category).
Applicant must have either 4th standard education or 1 year work experience in the trade.

name: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Udyam Kranti Yojana (MUKY)
agency: Department of MSME, Government of Madhya Pradesh
interest_rate_note: 3% annual interest subsidy for 7 years reduces effective bank rate from ~9.5% to ~6.5% p.a.
subsidy_margin_note: 3% p.a. interest subsidy for 7 years + 100% CGTMSE collateral guarantee fee reimbursed by MP Government.
overview: Helps educated youth aged 18–45 in Madhya Pradesh launch manufacturing units (₹1L–₹50L) or service/retail enterprises (₹50K–₹25L) without collateral. MP Government provides a 3% annual interest subsidy for 7 years plus full CGTMSE guarantee fee coverage.
key_highlights: 3% p.a. interest subsidy for 7 full years on bank loans
Free CGTMSE collateral guarantee cover paid by MP Govt
Up to ₹50,00,000 for manufacturing; ₹25,00,000 for service/retail
Generous ₹12,00,000 annual family income ceiling
required_documents: Madhya Pradesh Samagra ID & Domicile Certificate
Annual Family Income Certificate (<= ₹12,00,000)
Educational Certificate (min 8th class pass)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Detailed Project Report
Machinery / Shop Equipment Quotations
important_notes: Strictly for Madhya Pradesh residents aged 18–45 with family income <= ₹12,00,000.
Minimum 8th class pass required; service/retail loans cap at ₹25L while manufacturing goes to ₹50L.
Apply via MP Samast portal (samast.mponline.gov.in) before visiting your bank.

name: West Bengal Bhabishyat Credit Card (WB-BCC)
agency: MSME & Textiles Department, Government of West Bengal
interest_rate_note: State interest subvention & bank credit tie-up targets ~4%–6% net effective interest up to ₹5 lakh.
subsidy_margin_note: 10% Margin Money subsidy up to ₹25,000 + West Bengal Govt guarantee coverage (zero third-party collateral).
overview: West Bengal's flagship youth credit card scheme empowering citizens aged 18–45 to start micro-enterprises in manufacturing, service, trading, or agro-allied sectors up to ₹5 lakh. Includes ₹25,000 state margin money subsidy and state credit guarantee cover.
key_highlights: 10% state margin money subsidy up to ₹25,000
State-backed credit guarantee — zero collateral required up to ₹5L
Low effective ~4% p.a. concessional interest support
No annual family income ceiling for West Bengal residents
required_documents: West Bengal Residence Proof (min 10 years stay)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Age Proof (18–45 years)
Project Plan / Quotation for business assets
Bank Account Passbook
Bhabishyat Credit Card online registration slip
important_notes: Applicant must have resided in West Bengal for at least 10 years and be aged 18–45.
Only one member per family can avail the Bhabishyat Credit Card scheme.
Margin money grant is capped at ₹25,000 (10% of project cost).

name: Karnataka Udyogini Women Enterprise Scheme
agency: Karnataka State Women's Development Corporation (KSWDC)
interest_rate_note: Standard bank interest (~8.5%–10% p.a.) applies only on loan portion net of 30%–50% KSWDC capital subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: 50% subsidy (max ₹1.5L) for SC/ST women; 30% subsidy (max ₹90K) for General/OBC/Special women on loans up to ₹3 lakh.
overview: Empowers women entrepreneurs in Karnataka aged 18–55 to start small retail, tailoring, dairy, bakery, or service ventures up to ₹3 lakh. Provides 30% to 50% capital subsidy directly through the Karnataka State Women's Development Corporation.
key_highlights: 50% subsidy for SC/ST women and 30% subsidy for General/OBC women
Loans up to ₹3,00,000 across 88 notified small enterprise trades
Collateral-free bank linkage through PSBs and Grameena banks
Free 3–6 day KSWDC Entrepreneurship Development training
required_documents: Karnataka Domicile / Ration Card & Aadhaar Card
Family Income Certificate (<= ₹1.5L General / <= ₹2L SC-ST; relaxed for widows/PwD)
Caste Certificate (for 50% SC/ST subsidy slab)
Quotations & Training / Project Plan
Bank Passbook and 2 passport photographs
important_notes: Strictly for women residents of Karnataka aged 18–55 years.
Note: KSWDC official income ceiling is ₹1.5L (General) and ₹2L (SC/ST) except widows/destitute/disabled women.
Verify active district quota on KSWDC portal or Seva Sindhu before applying.

name: Telangana T-PRIDE SC/ST Industrial Incentive Scheme
agency: Industries & Commerce Department (TS-iPASS), Government of Telangana
interest_rate_note: Pavala Vaddi / 3%–6% interest reimbursement on bank term loan reduces effective rate significantly.
subsidy_margin_note: 35% investment subsidy for SC/ST men and 45% for SC/ST women (capped up to ₹75,00,000) + power & stamp duty reimbursement.
overview: Telangana's dedicated industrial incentive programme offering 35% investment subsidy (45% for SC/ST women) up to ₹75 lakh to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs. Also provides Pavala Vaddi interest reimbursement, power subsidy, and 100% stamp duty reimbursement.
key_highlights: 35%–45% capital investment subsidy up to ₹75,00,000
Extra 10% subsidy (45% total) exclusively for SC/ST women
Interest subsidy (Pavala Vaddi) + ₹1.50/unit power tariff rebate
21% plot reservation in TSIIC industrial parks
required_documents: Telangana SC / ST Community Certificate
TS-iPASS Acknowledgement & Udyam Registration
Bank Term Loan Sanction Letter & Disbursement Statement
CA-certified Fixed Capital Investment & Invoices
Aadhaar, PAN, and Land/Factory Lease Agreement
important_notes: Strictly for 100% SC/ST-owned enterprises operating in Telangana.
Subsidy is released post-commencement of commercial production via TS-iPASS portal.
Transport vehicles for SC/ST entrepreneurs are also covered under T-PRIDE guidelines.

name: Odisha Mukhyamantri Krushi Udyog Yojana (MKUY)
agency: APICOL / Department of Agriculture & FE, Government of Odisha
interest_rate_note: Standard bank agri-enterprise term loan rate (~8.5%–10.5% p.a.) applied on non-subsidized project loan.
subsidy_margin_note: 40% Capital Investment Subsidy for General men and 50% for Women/SC/ST/Agri-Graduates (capped at ₹50L–₹1 Crore).
overview: Encourages commercial agri-enterprises in Odisha (dairy, poultry, fisheries, cold storage, agro-processing, horticulture) with a massive 40% to 50% capital investment subsidy. Women, SC, ST, and agri-graduate founders qualify for the 50% subsidy slab up to ₹1 crore.
key_highlights: 50% subsidy for Women/SC/ST/Agri-Graduates; 40% for General
Supports projects up to ₹1 Crore+ across agri-allied & processing
Single-window online submission via Odisha SUGAM portal
No annual family income ceiling for Odisha agri-entrepreneurs
required_documents: Odisha Residence Proof, Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
Land Ownership Record (ROR / Patta) or 10-year registered lease
Caste / Women / Agri-Graduate Certificate (for 50% subsidy)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) per APICOL guidelines
Bank Appraisal / Consent Letter & Geo-tagged site coordinates
important_notes: Strictly for commercial agriculture, livestock, fishery, and agro-processing units in Odisha.
Subsidy is released back-ended only after verified unit completion and APICOL inspection.
Requires valid agricultural/commercial land title or registered long-term lease.

name: Assam Chief Minister's Atmanirbhar Asom Abhijan (CMAAA)
agency: Industries, Commerce & Public Enterprise Dept., Government of Assam
interest_rate_note: 0% interest-free government soft loan (50% grant + 50% interest-free loan repaid after 5-year moratorium).
subsidy_margin_note: ₹2,00,000 standard package (₹1L grant + ₹1L 0% loan) or ₹5,00,000 for professional degree holders (₹2.5L grant + ₹2.5L 0% loan).
overview: Assam's youth self-employment mission offering ₹2 lakh (up to ₹5 lakh for engineering/medical/agri/MBA graduates) as 50% outright government grant and 50% interest-free soft loan. Aims to build self-reliant micro-enterprises across Assam without bank collateral.
key_highlights: 50% outright Govt Grant + 50% Interest-Free (0%) Soft Loan
₹2,00,000 standard support; ₹5,00,000 for technical/professional graduates
Zero collateral and direct state-portal DBT disbursement
Includes mandatory 1-month business management training
required_documents: Assam Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) & Employment Exchange ID
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Age Proof (18–40/45 years)
Educational Qualification (10th pass / Degree for ₹5L tier)
Project Proposal in agriculture, poultry, dairy, retail, or services
Bank Account Passbook (Assam branch)
important_notes: Strictly for unemployed permanent residents of Assam registered with Assam Employment Exchange.
Age cap is 18–40 (General) and 18–43/45 (SC/ST/OBC).
₹5,00,000 tier requires a professional degree (BE/BTech, MBBS, Agri, Vet, Fishery, MBA).

name: Haryana Mukhyamantri Antyodaya Parivar Utthan Yojana (MMAPUY)
agency: Citizen Resources Information Department (CRID), Government of Haryana
interest_rate_note: Interest subvention reimburses up to 7%–8% on Antyodaya loans so net effective cost is ~4%–6% p.a.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 state margin subsidy (paired with SC/BC/Women Corp or MUDRA/PMEGP loans up to ₹5L).
