overview: Haryana's targeted upliftment mission for Antyodaya families with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) verified income up to ₹1.80 lakh per annum. Provides subsidized livelihood loans up to ₹5 lakh across dairy, shops, tailoring, and micro-units via Antyodaya Melas and Saral Haryana.
key_highlights: Targeted specifically at Antyodaya families (PPP income <= ₹1.80L)
Combines state margin subsidy with low-interest bank/SCA credit
Single-window sanction camps via Antyodaya Melas & Saral portal
Covers dairy, e-rickshaw, kirana, beauty parlour & artisan trades
required_documents: Haryana Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP / Family ID)
Verified Family Income <= ₹1,80,000 in PPP database
Aadhaar Card and Haryana Residence Proof
Caste Certificate (if SC/BC for additional state corp subsidy)
Bank Passbook and chosen livelihood quote
important_notes: Strictly restricted to Haryana families with verified PPP annual income <= ₹1,80,000.
Applicants earning above ₹1.80L are ineligible for MMAPUY — check PMMY or PMEGP instead.
Loans are routed via Saral Haryana and district Antyodaya Melas.

name: Punjab PSCFC Self-Employment Loan Scheme
agency: Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation (PSCFC)
interest_rate_note: 6%–8% p.a. concessional interest rate depending on loan slab and direct PSCFC vs bank tie-up.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to ₹10,000–₹50,000 state SC subsidy (for BPL/eligible slabs) + up to 90% financing via PSCFC & NSFDC.
overview: Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation provides concessional direct and bank-tied loans up to ₹15 lakh at 6%–8% interest for SC residents of Punjab. Supports dairy farming, shops, transport vehicles, and small workshops.
key_highlights: Low 6%–8% p.a. concessional interest for Punjab SC applicants
Up to ₹15,00,000 for businesses, dairy, shops & commercial vehicles
State capital subsidy support for eligible low-income households
Direct district-level servicing through PSCFC offices
required_documents: Punjab Scheduled Caste (SC) Certificate
Punjab Residence / Domicile Certificate
Annual Family Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and 2 Passport Photos
Project Quotation / Vehicle Proforma & Guarantor KYC
important_notes: Strictly for Scheduled Caste permanent residents of Punjab with family income <= ₹5,00,000.
Direct PSCFC loans above ₹1 lakh typically require a government-employee or property guarantor.
Apply at your district PSCFC office or Punjab state portal.

name: Kerala KFC Chief Minister's Entrepreneurship Development Programme (CMEDP)
agency: Kerala Financial Corporation (KFC)
interest_rate_note: ~5%–7% p.a. effective interest (KFC base rate ~9%–10% with 3%–5% Kerala Govt interest subvention for 5 years).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 90% project finance up to ₹1 Crore (₹2 Cr for existing units) with 3%–5% state interest subvention.
overview: Kerala Financial Corporation's flagship MSME & startup term loan providing up to ₹1 crore at an effective 5%–7% interest rate after state government interest subvention. Designed for new and growing enterprises in Kerala with streamlined KFC branch sanction.
key_highlights: Effective ~5%–7% p.a. rate after Kerala Govt interest subvention
High financing ceiling up to ₹1 Crore (90% of project cost)
6-month moratorium and up to 7–10 year repayment options
Open to all categories with no family income limit in Kerala
required_documents: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Kerala Address Proof
Udyam Registration & Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Machinery / Construction Quotations
Collateral / CGTMSE coverage documents per loan quantum
12 months Bank Statement & Partnership/Company Deed (if any)
important_notes: Strictly for enterprises located in Kerala (minimum loan size generally ₹5 lakh).
Interest subvention reimbursement applies for the first 5 years on timely repayment.
Smaller micro-loans (< ₹5L) are better served by PMMY or Kudumbashree.

name: Andhra Pradesh APSCCFC Self-Employment Loan Scheme
agency: AP Scheduled Castes Cooperative Finance Corporation (APSCCFC)
interest_rate_note: 6% p.a. concessional interest on bank/NSFDC loan component alongside APSCCFC subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: Up to 50%–60% state corporation subsidy (max ₹1L–₹2L) combined with bank/NSFDC credit up to ₹5 lakh.
overview: Supports Scheduled Caste families in Andhra Pradesh (annual income up to ₹3 lakh) to set up dairy, retail shops, mini-transport, or service units up to ₹5 lakh. Combines APSCCFC capital subsidy with low-interest bank or NSFDC financing.
key_highlights: State capital subsidy combined with concessional 6% bank credit
Covers dairy, small shops, transport & artisan units up to ₹5L
Online processing via Andhra Pradesh OBMMS portal
Prioritizes BPL / Rice Card SC households
required_documents: Andhra Pradesh Integrated Caste Certificate (SC)
Income Certificate / White Ration (Rice) Card (<= ₹3,00,000)
Aadhaar Card & AP Residence Proof
Bank Account Passbook & Unit Quotation
OBMMS Online Application Acknowledgement
important_notes: Strictly for Scheduled Caste residents of Andhra Pradesh with annual income <= ₹3,00,000.
Subsidy percentage depends on annual AP state budget slab and unit category.
Must register online on apobmms.apcfss.in during active district call windows.

name: Delhi DSFDC Composite Self-Employment Loan
agency: Delhi SC/ST/OBC/Minorities & Handicapped Financial & Development Corp. (DSFDC)
interest_rate_note: 6%–8% p.a. concessional interest across income-generating trades (4%–5% for special women/PwD windows).
subsidy_margin_note: Up to ₹10,000–₹20,000 grant-in-aid for eligible SC BPL/low-income brackets + 90% concessional loan up to ₹10 lakh.
overview: Delhi Government's DSFDC corporation offers concessional loans up to ₹10 lakh at 6%–8% interest for SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and PwD residents of Delhi. Supports retail shops, service centres, e-autos/taxis, and small workshops.
key_highlights: Concessional 6%–8% p.a. loans up to ₹10,00,000 in Delhi NCT
Covers SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and Divyangjan residents
Supports commercial vehicles, shops, clinics & small manufacturing
Direct online filing via DSFDC portal (dsfdc.delhi.gov.in)
required_documents: Delhi Caste / Minority Certificate (issued in NCT of Delhi)
Delhi Residence Proof (min 5 years stay in Delhi)
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Guarantor Details
Project Report / Quotation & Commercial DL (if vehicle)
important_notes: Strictly for SC, ST, OBC, and Minority residents living in Delhi for at least 5 years.
Family annual income ceiling is ₹5,00,000 (₹3L for ST/some specific corporation lines).
Requires 1–2 solvent guarantors (or collateral) as per DSFDC loan slab.

name: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Rozgar Srijan Yojana (CMRSY)
agency: Welfare Dept. / SC, ST, OBC & Minority Corporations, Govt. of Jharkhand
interest_rate_note: Simple 6% p.a. concessional interest charged on the net loan after 40% state grant subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: Flat 40% Capital Subsidy (up to ₹5,00,000) directly from Jharkhand Govt; loans up to ₹50,000 require zero guarantor.
overview: Provides subsidized self-employment loans up to ₹25 lakh at 6% simple interest for SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and PwD youth aged 18–50 in Jharkhand. Features a generous 40% capital grant capped at ₹5 lakh.
key_highlights: 40% capital subsidy (up to ₹5,00,000 grant) on approved units
6% simple interest rate — among the lowest state loan rates
Loans up to ₹25,00,000 for vehicles, shops, dairy & workshops
Zero guarantor needed for micro loans up to ₹50,000
required_documents: Jharkhand Local Resident (Domicile) Certificate
Caste / Minority Certificate (SC / ST / OBC / Minority)
Annual Family Income Certificate (<= ₹5,00,000)
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Age Proof (18–50 years)
Project Quotation & Commercial Licence (if passenger/goods vehicle)
important_notes: Strictly for SC, ST, OBC, and Minority permanent residents of Jharkhand aged 18–50.
Annual family income ceiling is ₹5,00,000.
Loans above ₹50,000 require a government/PSU employee or property guarantor.

name: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarozgar Yojana (MMYSY)
agency: Directorate of Industries, Government of Chhattisgarh
interest_rate_note: Standard bank MSME interest (~8.5%–10% p.a.) applied on balance net of 10%–25% state capital subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: 25% subsidy up to ₹1.5L (SC/ST/Women/OBC/PwD/Naxal-affected) or 10%–15% (General up to ₹1L); max ₹25L mfg / ₹10L service / ₹2L business.
overview: Helps unemployed youth aged 18–35 in Chhattisgarh (family income up to ₹3 lakh) establish manufacturing (up to ₹25L), service (up to ₹10L), or trading (up to ₹2L) units. Offers 10% to 25% margin money subsidy through District Trade & Industries Centres.
key_highlights: 10%–25% state margin money subsidy up to ₹1,50,000
Up to ₹25,00,000 for manufacturing (₹10L service, ₹2L retail)
Only 5% own contribution for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD (10% General)
Collateral-free support via CGTMSE guidelines
required_documents: Chhattisgarh Domicile Certificate
Family Annual Income Certificate (<= ₹3,00,000)
8th Class Marksheet & Age Proof (18–35/40 years)
Caste Certificate (for 25% subsidy & age relaxation)
Aadhaar Card, Project Report & Machinery Quotations
important_notes: Strictly for Chhattisgarh residents with annual family income <= ₹3,00,000.
Manufacturing goes up to ₹25L, whereas Service caps at ₹10L and Retail Trade at ₹2L.
Age limit is 18–35 (relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD).

name: Uttarakhand Mukhyamantri Swarozgar Yojana (MSY)
agency: Directorate of Industries, Government of Uttarakhand
interest_rate_note: Standard bank MSME loan rate (~8.5%–10% p.a.) applied on balance net of 15%–25% state margin subsidy.
subsidy_margin_note: 25% margin subsidy in Category A hill districts, 20% in Category B, and 15% in Category C/D plains; max project ₹25L mfg / ₹10L service.
overview: Uttarakhand's premier self-employment credit-linked subsidy scheme supporting local youth, migrants, and entrepreneurs setting up manufacturing (up to ₹25L) or service/business (up to ₹10L) enterprises. Offers 15% to 25% capital subsidy graded by hill and plain district zones.
key_highlights: 25% subsidy in Hill Districts (20% mid-hill, 15% plains)
Up to ₹25,00,000 for manufacturing (₹10,00,000 for service/trade)
No annual family income limit for Uttarakhand residents
Only 5%–10% promoter margin money contribution
required_documents: Uttarakhand Permanent Residence / Domicile Certificate
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Bank Passbook
Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Vendor Quotations
Caste / Ex-Serviceman / PwD Certificate (if applicable)
MSY Portal Online Application Slip
important_notes: Strictly for Uttarakhand residents setting up units inside the state.
Subsidy slab (15%/20%/25%) depends on the district's Hill/Plain classification under MSY.
Maximum project cost for service and trading sectors is ₹10 lakh (₹25L for manufacturing).

name: Himachal Pradesh Mukhya Mantri Swavalamban Yojana (MMSY)
agency: Department of Industries, Government of Himachal Pradesh
interest_rate_note: 5% p.a. state interest subsidy for 3 years (on loans up to ₹60L) lowers effective bank interest to ~4%–5% p.a.
subsidy_margin_note: 25% capital subsidy on machinery/equipment (30% for HP women, 35% for widows) up to ₹60L plant/machinery (max project ₹1 Crore).
overview: Encourages Himachali youth (18–45 years; up to 50 for women) to launch self-employment units up to ₹1 crore with 25%–35% capital subsidy on machinery and equipment. Also provides a 5% annual interest subsidy for the first 3 years.
key_highlights: 25% capital subsidy (30% Women, 35% Widows) on machinery
Additional 5% p.a. interest subsidy for 3 full years
Supports manufacturing, homestays, cold storage & services up to ₹1 Cr
50% land lease/stamp duty concession in HP industrial areas
required_documents: Himachali Bonafide Resident Certificate
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Age Proof (18–45 / 50 women)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) & Machinery Quotations
Category / Widow Certificate (for 30%–35% enhanced subsidy)
Emerging Himachal Portal Online Application
important_notes: Strictly for bona fide residents of Himachal Pradesh aged 18–45 (up to 50 for women).
Capital subsidy applies specifically on plant & machinery/equipment up to ₹60 lakh within ₹1 Cr project.
Approved activities include manufacturing, tourism homestays, cold storage, and eligible services.

name: Jammu & Kashmir Mission Youth MUMKIN / Tejaswini
agency: Mission Youth, Government of Jammu & Kashmir
interest_rate_note: Standard J&K Bank / PSB rate (~8.5%–9.5% p.a.); 10% interest subvention under Tejaswini for young women entrepreneurs.
subsidy_margin_note: 10%–20% upfront capital subsidy (up to ₹80,000–₹1,00,000 under MUMKIN + 10% manufacturer discount; ₹50,000 under Tejaswini).
overview: Mission Youth J&K supports unemployed youth aged 18–35 to purchase small commercial vehicles under MUMKIN (10%–20% upfront subsidy + OEM discount) or start women-led businesses up to ₹5L–₹10L under Tejaswini. Delivered collateral-free through J&K Bank and nationalized banks.
key_highlights: 10%–20% upfront subsidy (plus 10% OEM discount under MUMKIN)
Zero own margin money and zero collateral required
Tejaswini offers extra 10% interest subvention for young J&K women
Fast district-level approval via Mission Youth portal
required_documents: J&K Domicile Certificate
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Age Proof (18–35 years)
Unemployed Youth Self-Declaration / Employment Exchange ID
Valid Commercial Driving Licence (for MUMKIN vehicle loans)
Vehicle / Enterprise Quotation & J&K Bank Account
important_notes: Strictly for domiciled unemployed youth of Jammu & Kashmir aged 18–35.
MUMKIN targets small commercial vehicles, while Tejaswini supports women-led shops/services up to ₹5L.
Applicants must not be in government or regular private salaried employment.

name: Goa Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY)
agency: Economic Development Corporation (EDC Ltd.), Government of Goa
interest_rate_note: Fixed 2%–4% p.a. simple interest rate (2% for women, SC/ST, OBC & professionals; 4% general; 1% timely rebate).
subsidy_margin_note: Direct EDC soft loan up to ₹25,00,000 at 2%–4% simple interest + 2%–10% low promoter contribution.
overview: Goa's flagship direct self-employment loan implemented by EDC Limited offering up to ₹25 lakh at ultra-low 2% to 4% simple interest. Covers small industries, tourist taxis/vehicles, clinics, retail, and service enterprises for Goan youth.
key_highlights: Ultra-low 2%–4% simple interest rate (1% rebate on timely EMI)
Direct financing up to ₹25,00,000 via EDC Goa (no bank middleman)
Only 2%–5% promoter contribution for special categories
6-month moratorium and up to 7-year repayment term
required_documents: Goa 15-Year Residence / Domicile Certificate
Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and Birth Certificate (18–45 yrs)
Educational / Professional Qualification Proof
Project Report & Equipment / Vehicle Proforma Invoice
Guarantor KYC / Security details per EDC norms
important_notes: Strictly for residents living in Goa for at least 15 years (age 18–45, relaxed to 50 for special categories).
Applied directly via EDC Goa (edc-goa.com), not through commercial bank branches.
Family annual income should generally not exceed ₹8L–₹10L per latest EDC circular.
